summary: ZTO Express (Cayman) Inc. furnished a Form 6-K with five Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Returns covering share repurchases on the US market between August 12 and August 19, 2026. The company bought back American depositary shares at prices from USD 21.22 to USD 23.00 per ADS, each representing one Class A ordinary share, with repurchased shares held pending cancellation. Issued shares remained 557,330,906 as of early October. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or closing condition was stated. The filing reflects an ongoing open-market buyback program; watch execution pace and cancellations.
